## US Stocks Close Wild July Higher as Amazon Soars, Apple Sinks; Inflation Worries Intensify

Divergence between two mega-cap tech names at month-end, combined with worsening inflation sentiment, signals selective rather than broad-based risk appetite — worth monitoring whether AAPL weakness is idiosyncratic or an early multiple-compression signal for rate-sensitive tech.

- Equities managed a positive finish to what headlines describe as a volatile July, despite mounting inflation concerns.
- Amazon was among the session's standout gainers while Apple underperformed significantly — a notable intra-tech divergence.
- Inflation worries are explicitly flagged as worsening alongside the equity rally, creating cross-asset tension.
- Month-end positioning likely amplified single-name dispersion between AMZN and AAPL.
